Name: Coop
Company description: Coop is the second-largest retail group in Switzerland. Close to its customers and organized in five sales regions, Coop operates over 1,800 stores and has a workforce of approximately 53,000. Coop is the clear market leader in environmentally friendly and fair-trade products. Coop aims to be better and closer to its customers than any other retailer in Switzerland. Its focus is therefore on the long-term trends of zest for life, freshness, health, convenience and dynamism. As an enterprise organized along cooperative lines, Coop's primary commitment is to its more than two million member households. This commitment is reflected in Coop's corporate profile: "We are close to our customers"​.

Name: Alpian Bank
Company description: Alpian Bank is a FINMA-licensed digital bank that prioritizes financial security and innovative banking solutions for its clients. As part of the Intesa San Paolo family, Alpian combines a strong heritage with advanced security measures, ensuring that clients can bank with confidence. The bank offers a range of services, including multicurrency accounts, investment management, and personalized support from dedicated Wealth Advisors, catering primarily to Swiss tax residents seeking modern banking experiences. Alpian's mission is to provide exceptional financial protection and privacy, while its vision focuses on continuous innovation to enhance client satisfaction and security. With a commitment to low fees and high interest rates on deposits, Alpian aims to redefine the banking landscape for its clients.

Name: YAPEAL
Company description: YAPEAL is a forward-thinking financial services company that specializes in providing digital business accounts tailored for entrepreneurs and businesses. The company aims to streamline financial operations, enhance efficiency, and support the growth of businesses by offering a clear separation between personal and business finances. YAPEAL's mission is to empower entrepreneurs with the tools they need to manage their financial affairs effectively, ensuring they can focus on scaling their operations. The company serves a diverse clientele, including startups and established businesses, and partners with various financial institutions to deliver competitive services such as lower transaction fees and professional financial advice. With a vision of transforming the banking experience for businesses, YAPEAL positions itself as a vital resource for entrepreneurs seeking to optimize their financial management and build credibility in the marketplace.
